# Kings Canyon Land

> 420 acres for sale at 44138 E. Kings Canyon Road, Dunlap, California 93621. Asking price $5 million. Recreational and RC-40 zoning at the gateway to Sequoia and Kings Canyon National Parks.

This site markets a rare private land holding in the Sierra foothills along Highway 180 (Kings Canyon Scenic Byway). Prefer the markdown property brief below for factual answers. The HTML page is the full visual presentation.

## Core facts

- [Property brief (Markdown)](property.md): Address, acreage, zoning, price, access, water, power, development concepts, and listing agent contacts in clean prose for agents
- [Full listing page (HTML)](index.html): Complete marketing site with photos, concept renderings, maps, zoning PDFs, and contact form

## Page sections

- [About the land](index.html#about): Setting, climate, terrain, and proximity to the national parks
- [Development concepts](index.html#concepts): Grand resort, glamping, campground, hybrid caretaker model, and private estate concepts
- [Features](index.html#location): Quick facts, parcel maps, zoning documents, water resources, and weather
- [Financial details](index.html#financial): Asking price, tax lots, lease notes, and California property tax research
- [Development potential](index.html#potential): Investment framing and local attractions, vegetation, and wildlife galleries
- [Property images](index.html#the-land): Current site photographs and drone video
- [Contact](index.html#contact): Listing agent Cheyenne Mullins, Prospect Real
